project: Dungeon Quest - Debug Cheats Sandbox Reference
status: UI/catalog prototype v39; mobile-short-height layout refined; all values are local drafts only; not integrated into APK
principles: Cheats are registered by stable IDs; UI labels are not identity keys.
All effects require a verified game adapter handler. Unmapped entries must be disabled and visibly marked.
Cheats apply only to a disposable sandbox profile, not the original save.
No cheat may grant or forge real-money purchase entitlement, bypass account checks, or write to cloud/leaderboard state.
Actions are requests, not direct mutations: the adapter validates args, current scene, permission and safe position before execution.
Enable/disable and parameter changes are audited and reversible where the adapter supports snapshots.
High/critical-risk entries require explicit confirmation and a sandbox-only warning.
The Active (staging) filter includes only enabled toggles/actions and non-default staged numeric/range/select values; default ranges are not treated as active.

Player & Survival.description: Health, survivability, resources, movement and player-stat overrides.

Combat Lab.description: Damage, hit rules, crits, hitboxes and combat telemetry.

Enemy AI.description: Enemy behavior, targeting, difficulty and AI visualization.

Loot & RNG.description: Drops, rarity, reproducible random seeds and loot diagnostics.

Economy Lab.description: Local-only economy simulation; must never touch purchase entitlements.

Progression Lab.description: Unlock, quest and level overrides within the disposable sandbox.

Inventory & Gear.description: Inventory stress tests and sandbox-only item fixtures.

Spawn & Encounter Lab.description: Spawn/cleanup operations for tagged disposable entities.

World & Physics.description: Movement, collision, world clock and environment overrides.

Camera & Visuals.description: Camera, renderer and visual debugging controls.

UI & Accessibility.description: HUD, viewport, input test modes and accessibility overlays.

Gear & Stats Lab.description: Equipment stat aggregation, set-bonus and affix diagnostics.

Debug Tools.description: Snapshots, logs, assertions, local test suites and save guards.
